objective: Expose positive energy-resolved H1 primary source atoms from unchanged admitted continuous photon history at actual GRID044 endpoint.

fixed_inputs.normalizers: endpoint inputs/AGGREGATE_PAYLOAD.json source_normalizers_reused; do not recompute
fixed_inputs.actual_target: H1_0 by exact species label in actual_abundance_per_ref

algorithm.instruction: Extract H1-only positive atom emission from existing opacity_response.production loops preserving time roots/angular cuts/log-E mapping exactly. Use original SavedBackground and native atomic sigma. Never call full production or oracle suite.
algorithm.array_storage: uncompressed NPZ arrays: E_observer_eV, E_electron_eV, optionally E_birth_eV; per_source_A and per_source_weight_ref; no JSON serialization of all atoms
outputs: source-qualified H1 primary measure with identity/domain/frame/normalization
provider readiness packet: stopping unqualified, thermal null

acceptance.same_quadrature_moments_scale: abs(actual-reference)/abs(reference) for each strictly positive source/quantity
acceptance.derivative_scale: max(abs analytic derivative row entries) per output row; exact-zero rows require exact zero; no max(1) for tiny physical units
acceptance.inherited_continuum_evidence: prior saved production/fine/oracle; not rerun, applies original moments only
acceptance.finite_support: all E finite, 13.6<=Egamma<=150, epsilon>=0, all A/weights finite nonnegative; no tolerance clipping
negative_controls: drop factor r: same-moment check rejects
replace observer E with birth E: energy moment check rejects
omit chi subtraction: kinetic moment check rejects
unadmitted HE stopping input: no heat output
boundary_controls: y=0 gives exact zero weights and finite analytic derivative
alpha_s=0 gives exact zero selected source weights and finite derivative
nonpositive r, negative y/amplitude, wrong frame/reference/source IDs rejected
acceptance.source_extents: two additive templates, one physical event owner

execution.cap_includes: scientific child including imports and array output, wrapper measured separately
execution.repair: No automatic replay. Preserve failed partial; return diagnosis to controller for one bounded explicitly authorized changed-input/code correction within remaining cumulative budget.

claims.admissible: finite positive energy-only source measure on same physical endpoint/prescribed history; moment/tangent correspondence after tests+review
